clips.caption:
Everyone selling on TV in the 80s used the same formula: testimonials, a fake studio audience, 'sell, sell, sell' into the camera.

Kevin Trudeau did the opposite. No testimonials. No studio audience. He never showed the product or mentioned the price - just an interview, and a number to call.

It broke every rule in the playbook. It also broke every sales record he'd ever had, because nobody watching felt sold to.

People love to buy. They hate being sold. Copy the room and you're invisible in it.

What's the industry 'formula' in your field that's actually just noise now?

#kevintrudeau #marketing #businessstrategy #entrepreneur #salestips #directresponse

clips.caption:
Everyone told Kevin Trudeau his email list was dead. He'd hit the same names for six months and sales had slowed to nothing.

His team said stop wasting money on that list. Kevin did the opposite - he mailed them a plain, eight-page letter. No design, just a letter and a QR code.

His team called it throwing money away on postage. Thirty days later, the return was 200% - every dollar back, plus one more.

Put up $100,000 and get $200,000 back every month, and the only question left is how often you want to do that.

'Dead' channels aren't dead. They're just empty of effort.

#kevintrudeau #directmail #marketing #smallbusiness #moneymindset #entrepreneur

Kevin Trudeau says breaking a bad habit starts with two words: cancel, cancel.

He moved to a new house and still drove to the old one out of pure habit, three times in a row. The first time he didn't notice until he was in the wrong driveway. By the third, he caught himself halfway there and said 'cancel, cancel' out loud.

Most people never catch it at all. He watched one person show up late to the same meeting for weeks, got called out for it, and still showed up late next time - unaware they were even doing it.

Awareness comes before willpower. You can't cancel a habit you don't know you're running.

#kevintrudeau #mindset #selfawareness #habits #personalgrowth #successmindset
